services.name: Self Defense
services.desc: If you are searching for the best self-defense classes in Houston TX, you are probably looking for something more serious than a workout with a few techniques added on. You may want to feel safer, more confident, and more capable if someone gets too close, grabs you, crowds you, or tries to intimidate you. You may also want training that respects the fact that you are an adult with real responsibilities, limited time, and practical goals. Moy Tung Kung Fu Academy teaches Ving Tsun Kung Fu, commonly known as Wing Chun, as practical self-defense for adults.
